title: Determinant of the Risk of the Becoming Frail in the Non-dependent Elederly
official: Determinant of the Risk of the Becoming Frail in the Non-dependent Elederly
summary: As an active and healthy ageing, "Successful Ageing" is a societal challenge for all countries members according to the European Commission. This study is intended to contribute to increase healthy, active and non-dependent lifetime. To this end the main goal is to highlight clinical and biological frailty determinants in elderly with potential weaknesses.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria :

* Age ≥ 70 years old
* Patient with frailty risks according to a survey recommended by HAS (Gérontopôle of Toulouse)
* ADL≥5
* Agreeing to take part in a geriatric assessment in a prevention center or in a Day hospital in Île-de-France
* Agreeing to be followed by phone every 6 months for 3 years
* Eligible to a social security system

Exclusion criteria :

* A stated loss of autonomy
* Individual under guardianship, curatorship, judicial supervision
